title: DNOW Ranked in the 2026 Industrial Distribution Big 50
summary: DNOW ranked on the 2026 Industrial Distribution Big 50 list, an annual ranking of the industrial market's 50 largest global distributors based on revenue.
body_markdown:
After a significant 2025 highlighted by our successful combination with MRC Global, DNOW is proud to be included again on the annual *Industrial Distribution* Big 50 list for 2026. This ranking is determined by companies' most recent full-year worldwide revenue achieved through their North American operations.


#11
DNOW Inc.


## Ranking Methodology


The Big 50 list ranks companies according to their 2025 full-year global sales. All listed companies are based in North America, and only North American sales are accounted for. Master distributors are not eligible for inclusion.


Information for publicly traded companies is based on their annual and quarterly reports, earnings statements and company verifications. For non-publicly-traded and privately-held companies, self-reported data is used and supplemented with recently published press releases, company website information and other news reports. To be eligible for Big 50 consideration, company information had to be submitted to *Industrial Distribution* editorial staff via email, survey and by phone.

**About Industrial Distribution**
